data.name: Prosenjit
data.long_meaning: Prosenjit means one who has complete mastery over his senses and emotions. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'prosana' which means 'sense' and 'jit' which means 'mastery'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prosenjit is a name of Lord Shiva, who is known to have mastered his senses and emotions and is often depicted as the 'Adiyogi' or the first guru. The name signifies a person who has achieved inner peace and tranquility by mastering his senses and emotions.
data.numerology_meaning: Prosenjit is a name with a Life Path Number 3, which symbolizes creativity, self-expression and communication. People with this name are often artistic, communicative and have a natural ability to inspire others.
